caption:
雪白的毛髮
依舊保持優雅
即便身處戰場
她依然神情莊重
直到發現
那塊掉在地上的
小魚乾
scene: A hand-painted book illustration of 小雪, an elegant white long-haired cat with striking blue eyes and a tiny pink nose. She is sitting poised atop a chaotic mountain of colorful laundry, looking regal and dignified despite the mess, until she spots a single dried fish snack wedged deep in a stray sock.
